articles.description: Chicago Cubs LF Ian Happ, the former UC star, is a pending free agent with 4 Gold Gloves and a career .784 OPS. It's 1.002 in 66 career games at GABP.

articles.title: Another day, another team clinches against Reds as Dodgers win NL West
articles.description: The Los Angeles Dodgers outscored the Cincinnati Reds 41-15 to win 6 of 7 meetings over an 11-day span. That included an 8-2 win Thursday at GABP.
